modules.title: Present Simple — Oddiy hozirgi zamon
modules.video_title: Present Simple — English Grammar (eng yaxshi tushuntirish)
modules.theory: Present Simple nima uchun ishlatiladi? 1. Odatlar va rutinlar: I wake up at 7 every day. 2. Faktlar va umumiy haqiqatlar: The sun rises in the east. 3. Jadvallar: The train leaves at 9. Qanday yasash: • I / You / We / They + V1 → I work • He / She / It + V1 + s/es → She works Inkor: don't / doesn't + V1 Savol: Do / Does + subject + V1? 💡 Eslatma: -s/-es faqat 3-shaxs birlikda qo'shiladi!
modules.theory_oral: Present Simple — oddiy hozirgi zamon. U odatlar, faktlar va jadvallar uchun ishlatiladi. Men, sen, biz, ular bilan fe'l o'zgarmaydi. U, u (qiz), u (narsa) bilan fe'lga -s yoki -es qo'shiladi. Inkor uchun don't yoki doesn't, savol uchun Do yoki Does ishlatiladi.

exercises.question: My father ___ to work by car.
We ___ not watch TV at night.
___ it rain a lot in spring?

modules.title: Present Continuous — Davomiy hozirgi zamon
modules.video_title: Present Continuous — now va at the moment
modules.theory: Present Continuous (am/is/are + V-ing) 1. Hozir sodir bo'layotgan harakat: I am reading now. 2. Vaqtincha holat: She is living in Tashkent this month. 3. Kelajak rejalari (yaqin): We are meeting tomorrow. Yasalishi: • I am working • He/She/It is working • You/We/They are working ❌ Statik fe'llar (know, like, want, need...) odatda Continuous'da kelmaydi!
modules.theory_oral: Present Continuous — hozir davom etayotgan harakatlar uchun. Am, is yoki are + fe'lning -ing shakli. Masalan: I am studying. Statik fe'llar — bilmoq, yoqtirmoq kabilar — bu zamonda kam ishlatiladi.

exercises.question: They ___ not sleeping. They are talking.
She usually ___ tea, but today she ___ coffee.

modules.title: Past Simple — Oddiy o'tgan zamon
modules.video_title: Past Simple — regular va irregular verbs
modules.theory: Past Simple — o'tgan zamonda tugagan harakatlar. • Regular: V + ed → worked, played • Irregular: go→went, see→saw, have→had Inkor: didn't + V1 Savol: Did + subject + V1? Vaqt belgilari: yesterday, last week, in 2020, ago
modules.theory_oral: Past Simple — o'tgan zamonda bo'lib o'tgan va tugagan ishlar. Regular fe'llarga -ed qo'shiladi. Irregular fe'llar esa o'ziga xos shakl oladi: go — went, see — saw. Inkor va savolda did ishlatiladi, fe'l asosiy shaklda qoladi.

exercises.question: She ___ not come to the party.
We ___ a great film last weekend.
She ___ (finish) her homework an hour ago.

modules.title: Future Simple & Going to
modules.video_title: Will vs Going to — kelajak zamonlari
modules.theory: Will + V1: • Spontán qarorlar: I'll help you! • Bashoratlar: It will rain. • Va'dalar: I will call you. Be going to + V1: • Oldindan rejalashtirilgan: I'm going to study medicine. • Aniq belgilari bor bashorat: Look at those clouds — it's going to rain. Ikkalasi ham kelajakni bildiradi, lekin kontekst farq qiladi.
modules.theory_oral: Will — birdan qaror qilganda, va'da berishda yoki umumiy bashoratda. Going to — oldindan reja qilingan ishlar yoki aniq belgilarga asoslangan bashoratda ishlatiladi.

modules.title: Asosiy lug'at va artikllar
modules.theory: A / An — noaniq artikl (birinchi marta tilga olinganda): • a book (undosh) • an apple (unli tovush) The — aniq artikl (ma'lum narsa): • the book on the table ❌ Artiklsiz: ismlar, ko'plik umumiy ma'noda, tillar, ovqatlar (ba'zida).
modules.theory_oral: A va An — noaniq, birinchi marta aytganda. A — undosh bilan, An — unli tovush bilan. The — aniq, allaqachon ma'lum bo'lgan narsa uchun.

modules.title: Present Perfect
modules.theory: Present Perfect = have/has + V3 (Past Participle) 1. Hayotiy tajriba: I have been to Japan. 2. Hozirgacha davom etgan: She has lived here since 2015. 3. Yaqinda sodir bo'lgan, natijasi bor: I have lost my keys (hali topmadim). Belgilari: ever, never, just, already, yet, since, for
modules.theory_oral: Present Perfect — o'tgan bilan hozirni bog'laydi. Have yoki has + fe'lning uchinchi shakli. Tajriba, hozirgacha davom etgan ish yoki natijasi bor yaqin o'tgan uchun ishlatiladi.

exercises.question: He hasn't finished yet. 'Yet' qayerda keladi?
I ___ (never / see) such a beautiful place.

exercises.question: Present Perfect vs Past Simple: 'I ___ him yesterday.'

modules.title: Past Continuous
modules.theory: Past Continuous = was/were + V-ing • O'tgan zamonda davom etayotgan jarayon: I was reading when you called. • Parallel harakatlar: While she was cooking, he was watching TV. Ko'pincha Past Simple bilan birga keladi (kesishuvchi harakat).
modules.theory_oral: Past Continuous — o'tgan zamonda davom etayotgan ish. Was yoki were + -ing. Bir ish davom etayotganda boshqa ish sodir bo'lganini bildiradi.

modules.title: Conditionals (0 & 1)
modules.theory: Zero Conditional (umumiy haqiqat): If + Present Simple, Present Simple If you heat water, it boils. First Conditional (real kelajak): If + Present Simple, will + V1 If it rains, I will stay home.
modules.theory_oral: Zero Conditional — doimo rost bo'lgan narsalar uchun. First Conditional — kelajakda mumkin bo'lgan shart va uning natijasi uchun. If qismida Present, asosiy qismida will.

modules.title: Passive Voice (asoslari)
modules.theory: Passive = be (is/are/was/were...) + V3 Active: Millions of people read the book. Passive: The book was read by millions of people. Ijrochi muhim bo'lmasa yoki noma'lum bo'lsa ishlatiladi.
modules.theory_oral: Passive Voice — harakatni bajaruvchi emas, harakatning o'zi muhim bo'lganda. Be fe'li + fe'lning uchinchi shakli. Masalan: The house was built in 1990.

exercises.question: The book ___ by millions of people.

modules.title: Third Conditional & Wish
modules.theory: Third Conditional (o'tgan haqida afsus): If + Past Perfect, would have + V3 If I had known, I would have acted differently. Inversiya: Had I known, I would have... Wish + Past Perfect — o'tgan haqida afsus: I wish I had had more time yesterday.
modules.theory_oral: Third Conditional — o'tgan zamonda boshqacha bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan narsalar haqida. If + had + V3, would have + V3. Wish bilan ham o'tgan uchun Past Perfect ishlatiladi.

exercises.question: Had I known earlier, I ___ differently.

If I had known, I ___ come earlier.
If she had left earlier, she ___ the train.

modules.title: Inversion & Advanced structures
modules.theory: Inversion — odatdagi so'z tartibi o'zgaradi (rasmiy/adabiy uslub). Not only ___ late, but he also forgot the documents. → was he Seldom / Rarely / Never + yordamchi fe'l + subject By next year, she will have worked here for a decade. (Future Perfect)
modules.theory_oral: Inversion — Not only, Seldom kabi so'zlar bilan boshlanganda yordamchi fe'l subjectdan oldin keladi. Future Perfect — kelajakda ma'lum vaqtgacha tugagan ish: will have + V3.

exercises.question: Not only ___ late, but he also forgot the documents.
By next year, she ___ here for a decade.
By the time you arrive, we ___ dinner.

modules.title: Advanced Vocabulary
modules.theory: Yuqori darajadagi so'zlar: • Ambiguous — ikki xil talqin qilinadigan • Exacerbate — muammoni kuchaytirish • Meticulous — juda ehtiyotkor va aniq • Ubiquitous — hamma joyda mavjud
modules.theory_oral: Advanced vocabulary — noaniq, kuchaytirmoq, juda diqqatli, hamma joyda uchraydigan kabi so'zlarni o'rganamiz. Ular yozma va akademik nutqda ko'p uchraydi.
